create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed coefficients and U blocks for a given lmax and lmin
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels lmin through lmax using symmetry
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from Ra and Rb real and imaginary parts using precomputed coefficients
quaternion_to_ra_rb_real: decompose a quaternion tensor into the real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb
wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform Wigner D matrices from complex real-pair representation to real spherical harmonic basis
